sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹3,00,000; policy schedule determines actual SI)

room_rent.display: Single Private AC Room or 1% of SI/day (per Policy Schedule)
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private AC Room' or 'up to 1% of SI per day'. For SI>=5L with Optional Benefit: Room Rent and ICU Modification, room rent can be upgraded to No Sub-limit. NCB/NCBS amounts excluded from room rent limit calculation.

icu.note: Default is 2% of SI per day. For SI>=5L with Optional Benefit: Room Rent and ICU Modification, ICU becomes No Sub-limit. Policy Schedule specifies applicable limit.

copayment.display: None (base); 10% extra if eldest insured >70 yrs with Voluntary Co-pay opted
copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment by default. Optional Benefit: Voluntary Co-payment allows insured to choose a co-pay. If entry/renewal age >70 yrs, additional 10% co-pay applies over selected co-pay. Optional Benefit: Smart Select adds 20% co-pay for non-Annexure III hospitals.

sub_limits.display: Few optional sub-limits (cataract, knee, cancer, etc.)
sub_limits.note: Base plan has no disease sub-limits inbuilt. Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Specified Diseases (cataract, total knee replacement, CVA/CVD, cancer, renal diseases, long bone fractures) and Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Advance Technology Methods and Optional Benefit: Sub-Limit on Hospitalization related Expenses can add sub-limits if opted.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. A Deductible Option can be opted as per Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement date; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months from inception of first policy. Optional Benefit: Increase in PED Waiting Period can extend this. Optional Benefit: Instant Cover waives PED waiting for Diabetes/Hypertension/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma at first issuance.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (arthritis, ENT surgeries, BPH, cataract, hernia, varicose veins, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, etc.) have 24-month waiting period. If longer PED waiting applies, the longer period prevails.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered under hospitalization.

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB accrues at 25% flat per claim-free year, capped at 100% of SI. Reduced at same rate on claim. Optional Benefit: No Claim Bonus Super adds additional 50%/yr up to 100% of SI on top of NCB. Optional Benefit: Modification of No Claim Bonus reduces NCB to 10%/yr capped at 50%.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of base SI (same & different illness)
restoration.note: Automatic Recharge reinstates base SI once per policy year after full exhaustion of SI+NCB+NCBS+additional SIs. Usable for same or different illness. Optional Benefit: Unlimited Automatic Recharge extends this to unlimited times. Optional Benefit: Termination of Automatic Recharge removes this benefit.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission. Optional Benefit: Modification of Pre/Post Hospitalization reduces this to 30 days.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization expenses covered for 90 days after discharge; claim documents within 30 days after 90-day period. Optional Benefit: Modification reduces this to 60 days.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalization covered up to SI via reimbursement only. Certain diseases (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.) excluded under this benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) covered up to SI via cashless or reimbursement, subject to in-patient claim being admissible.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor medical expenses covered up to SI for harvesting surgery when insured is the recipient. Pre/post-hospitalization for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule. Air Ambulance available as Optional Benefit with separate limit.

modern_treatments.display: Covered up to SI (12 listed procedures)
modern_treatments.note: Advance Technology Methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to SI inbuilt. Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Advance Technology Methods can cap these if opted.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I are excluded. No optional rider for consumables cover identified in this wording.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly installment mode. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in installments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, alopecia, mental retardation, domiciliary for asthma/diabetes/hypertension/epilepsy etc.
optional_riders: Room Rent & ICU Modification, Unlimited Auto Recharge, OPD Care, OPD Consultation & Therapy, NCB Super, Voluntary Co-pay, Smart Select, Air Ambulance, Instant Cover (PED waiver), Disease Management Programs, Additional SI for Accident/Critical Illness
